title: Simple Meta-Learning for HPO and CASH Using Performance Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.07659v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bayesian optimization for Hyperparameter Optimization (HPO) and Combined Algorithm Selection and Hyperparameter Optimization (CASH) often relies on explicit hyperparameter encodings as surrogate inputs. In high-dimensional search spaces, however, such representations can make it difficult for standard surrogates to learn useful performance models. We instead study an alternative meta-learning representation that describes each configuration directly as its historical performance across prior tasks. This representation can be paired directly with standard surrogate models. Our scope is the iterative selection component of AutoML, deciding which configuration to evaluate next from a fixed candidate set, rather than a complete framework with features such as runtime estimation, cost-aware budgeting and ensembling. We further apply this representation to maximal marginal relevance (MMR), a diversity-based re-ranking criterion from recommende

translated_title: 基于性能表示的HPO与CASH简单元学习方法
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯优化在超参数优化（HPO）和组合算法选择与超参数优化（CASH）中通常依赖显式的超参数编码作为代理模型的输入。然而，在高维搜索空间中，这种表示方式使得标准代理模型难以学习到有用的性能模型。我们转而研究一种替代性的元学习表示方法，该方法直接将每个配置描述为其在先前任务上的历史性能表现。这种表示可以直接与标准代理模型配合使用。我们的研究范围是AutoML的迭代选择组件，即从固定的候选集合中决定下一个要评估的配置，而非包含运行时间估计、成本感知预算和集成等功能的完整框架。我们进一步将这种表示应用于最大边际相关性（MMR），这是一种来自推荐系统的基于多样性的重排序准则。
tldr: 提出一种简单有效的元学习表示方法，直接以配置在历史任务上的性能表现作为其表示，从而改进贝叶斯优化在HPO和CASH中的代理建模效果。
en_tdlr: Proposes a simple meta-learning representation that describes each configuration by its historical performance across prior tasks, improving surrogate-based Bayesian optimization for HPO and CASH.
